about_the_game:
The Last Seed is a 2D automation and strategy game set in a world where humanity has rendered the planet uninhabitable. You are the last remaining person, tasked with restoring nature and rebuilding life from a single surviving seed.

The atmosphere is poisoned, resources are scarce, and the environment is hostile. Your mission is to establish production chains, reclaim the ecosystem, and make the world livable again. But not everything in nature welcomes your intervention — some creatures will see your efforts as a threat.

In this world, you will:

  • Gather and process resources to build automated systems

  • Create evolving production lines to optimize efficiency

  • Manage humidity, temperature, and environmental conditions

  • Unlock new technologies to sustain life

  • Face resistance from a changing and reactive ecosystem

The Last Seed blends strategy, exploration, and environmental storytelling into an atmospheric gameplay experience. Every decision you make could shape the fate of a dying world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: The game runs well on low-end hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times.

short_description: Restore life on a dying planet in this 2D automation strategy game. Build production chains, reclaim the ecosystem, and survive a hostile world with the help of The Last Seed.
